landing.hero_subtitle: GNN Insight gives researchers a single, premium workspace for the entire graph-learning loop — from dataset upload to model comparison, with live training telemetry and audit-ready governance built in.
landing.capabilities_title: A research workspace built for graph people.
landing.capabilities_sub: Every feature is opinionated, fast, and gets out of your way. Train the model, not the tooling.
landing.feature_six_desc: Node, graph, link, community, embedding, generation — each task gets purpose-built panels for setup, training, and review.
landing.feature_models_desc: Swap encoders without rewriting the pipeline. Hyper-parameters and training context travel with every run.
landing.feature_live_desc: WebSocket-powered telemetry. Watch metrics, embeddings, and topology evolve epoch by epoch — no refresh needed.
landing.feature_replay_desc: Every session is snapshot-ready. Scrub back through training and compare versions with frame-accurate replay.
landing.feature_compare_desc: Stack experiments next to each other, diff metrics, and surface the variant worth promoting.
landing.feature_gov_desc: Role-based access, audit trails, and retention policy live in the admin shell — not as an afterthought.
landing.flow_sub: Four steps. No context-switching. Every result is reproducible by design.
landing.step_upload_text: Drop in a graph dataset and pick the task. Versioning, schema preview, and trainable context happen automatically.
landing.step_configure_text: Choose the encoder, hyper-parameters, and split policy. Defaults are sensible; overrides are explicit.
landing.step_train_text: Hit run and watch the live stream. Metrics, embeddings, and topology animate as the model converges.
landing.step_review_text: Replay any epoch, compare runs, and export research-grade reports for your team.
landing.cta_title: Bring graph research into a clean, modern shell.
landing.cta_sub: Sign in to your team's workspace, or open a fresh account and start your first experiment in minutes.

about.hero_subtitle: GNN Insight is an internal research platform for training, replaying, comparing, and governing Graph Neural Network experiments — assembled with the same care as the models it hosts.
about.mission_text: Give graph researchers one place to upload, train, replay, and compare experiments — without sacrificing governance, reproducibility, or design quality.
about.vision_text: A research shell that feels as crafted as the product surfaces of the best modern software — where the tool disappears and only the science remains.
about.principles_sub: These four ideas shape every decision — from the typography ramp to the audit schema.
about.v_researcher_text: We build for the moment between hypothesis and result. Every screen earns its place by getting you to the next decision faster.
about.v_govern_text: Audit trails, retention policy, and role-based access are not bolted on. They are the foundation under every run and dataset.
about.v_craft_text: Premium feels quiet. Typography breathes, motion is deliberate, and color is a tool — not a decoration.
about.v_repro_text: Replay any epoch, compare any run. If you cannot rerun the result tomorrow, the platform is not done helping you today.
about.quote_text: “Every visualization is a hypothesis. The interface should make that hypothesis easy to inspect, replay, and trust.”
about.journey_sub: A short tour through the milestones that shaped GNN Insight into what you see today.
about.tl1_text: GNN Insight began as an internal tool to compare GraphSAGE, GCN, and GAT variants without juggling notebooks and ad-hoc scripts.
about.tl2_text: We shipped epoch-streaming over WebSockets and the first replay timeline — making training feel like a film you can scrub through.
about.tl3_text: Projects, datasets, and version histories landed under one shell. Researchers stopped emailing CSVs around.
about.tl4_text: A dedicated admin surface for role management, session monitoring, retention preview, and audit activity.
about.tl5_text: A complete UI refresh: a refined design system, light and dark themes, and a public landing for the platform.
about.team_sub: We are a small group spanning research engineering, design, and governance — co-located inside the same shell we ship.
about.tm1_blurb: Builds the training kernels, snapshot pipeline, and the WebSocket replay engine.
about.tm2_blurb: Owns the visual language, motion system, and the researcher workflows end to end.
about.tm3_blurb: Designs retention policy, audit logging, and the admin surface that keeps the platform safe.
about.tm4_blurb: Shapes the six task experiences and validates them against real-world graph datasets.
about.cta_title: Spin up your first experiment in a clean shell.
about.cta_sub: Sign in to your team's workspace, or open a fresh account and bring your first graph dataset along.

public.footer_about: An internal platform for training, replaying, comparing, and governing Graph Neural Network experiments — built for graph researchers.
